effect.name: GM Alpha Feather Pro
effect.desc: Alpha-aware grow, choke and radial feather with premultiplied edge color recovery and safe zero default.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);float minA=src.a,maxA=src.a,avgA=src.a;vec3 rgb=src.rgb;float w=src.a;for(int i=0;i<16;i++){float a=float(i)*.3926991;vec4 c=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*radiusPx/sz,0.0,1.0));minA=min(minA,c.a);maxA=max(maxA,c.a);avgA+=c.a;rgb+=c.rgb*c.a;w+=c.a;}avgA/=17.0;float target=mix(avgA,grow>=0.0?maxA:minA,abs(grow));target=mix(src.a,target,softness);vec3 recovered=rgb/max(w,.0001);vec3 outRgb=preserveRgb?src.rgb:mix(src.rgb,recovered,edgeColorRecovery*step(src.a,target));vec4 dst=vec4(outRgb,target);gl_FragColor=mix(src,dst,mixAmount);}
